the preparation and evaluation of porous polyhydroxyalkonoate microspheres with different porosity as 3D cell carriers for cell growth and migration.
the preparation of biocompatible and biodegradable PHBVHHx porous microspheres and its application as a 3D cell carrier or scaffold for mammalian cell culture.
the design of biopolyester microspheres with controlled pore size and porosity as 3 D carriers for mammal cell growth.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the porous microspheres are the best choice among all the three microspheres for the cell culture system.
the porous PHBVHHxs microspheres can be used as 3D cell carrier or scaffold for mammalian cell cultivation.
the cell behaviors are strongly related to the morphology of the microspheres, which in turn is related to the preparation methods and conditions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the 3D carrier or scaffold can be prepared from biopolyesters with desired physical properties, and it is expected to be a new platform to study the cell growth and migration in a more realistic 3D environment.
the porous microspheres can be used as a carrier for cell growth, and the cell migration and cell growth are more active in porous PHBVHHX microspheres.
the 3 D porous structure of PMSs is a promising candidate for the development of biopolyester microspheres as a carrier or a scaffold for cell growth.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the porous PHBVHHX microsphere can serve as a scaffold for mammalian cell culture, and that the pore size of the scaffold can be tuned by adjusting the polymerization condition.

the cell behavior in suspension system is strongly affected by the microsphere structure and morphology, and the porous structure of microspheres may be a key factor in promoting mammalian cell growth and proliferation in suspension system.
the 3 D structure of the porous microspheres can be easily controlled by adjusting the polymer composition and the emulsion process.
